name: ANCFZ V2 | 01 | Lead creation | CONFIG REQUIRED

nodes.name: Receive Node Dispatch
nodes.notes: REQUIRED: configure Webhook Header Auth credential with X-Agentic-Internal-Secret (same value as the Node event-dispatch authentication header). Do not publish until all backend gates are ready.

nodes.name: Claim Authorized Action
nodes.notes: Credential deliberately not assigned; configure via the n8n Credentials UI, never in this repository.

nodes.name: Call Provider - Configure Credential

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({Name:$('Require V2 Stage Authorization').first().json.providerPayload.name,Company:$('Require V2 Stage Authorization').first().json.providerPayload.company,Phone:$('Require V2 Stage Authorization').first().json.providerPayload.phone,Email:$('Require V2 Stage Authorization').first().json.providerPayload.email,Description:$('Require V2 Stage Authorization').first().json.providerPayload.description}) }}

nodes.notes: Configure the approved Salesforce sandbox endpoint in REMOTE_CRM_LEAD_URL and assign a managed n8n OAuth2 credential before activation.

nodes.name: Read Back Provider State
nodes.notes: Configure REMOTE_CRM_LEAD_READ_URL as a {leadId} template. Never infer completion from POST 2xx; Node independently verifies this readback before stage completion.

nodes.name: Build Provider Evidence Payload
nodes.notes: Materialize trusted action correlation and provider readback before the Node evidence callback; an HTTP response does not retain upstream fields.

nodes.name: Ask Node to Verify Provider Evidence

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({actionId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.actionId,tenantId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.tenantId,sessionId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.sessionId,opportunityId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.opportunityId,catalogVersionId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.catalogVersionId,idempotencyKey:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.idempotencyKey,actionKey:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.actionKey,actionRevision:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.actionRevision,stageKey:'lead_generation',workflowKey:'crm.lead.create',providerRecordId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.providerRecordId,providerReadback:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.providerReadback,eventId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.eventId,correlationId:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.correlationId,attempt:$('Build Provider Evidence Payload').first().json.attempt}) }}

nodes.notes: The Node endpoint validates correlation and evidence. Deterministic mock evidence can complete only in development; Salesforce evidence remains reconciliation_required until a configured Node provider adapter performs independent readback. Assign internal Header Auth credential.

nodes.name: Complete Correlated Action
nodes.notes: Credential deliberately not assigned; configure via the n8n Credentials UI, never in this repository.

nodes.name: Report Correlated Failure

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const source = $('Validate Dispatch Envelope').first().json; const name = $prevNode?.name ?? ''; const reasonCode = name.includes('Provider') ? 'salesforce_create_failed' : name.includes('Read Back') ? 'salesforce_readback_failed' : name.includes('Verify') || name.includes('Attestation') ? 'provider_evidence_rejected' : 'node_completion_failed'; return { actionId: source.actionId, tenantId: source.tenantId, sessionId: source.sessionId, opportunityId: source.opportunityId, catalogVersionId: source.catalogVersionId, idempotencyKey: source.idempotencyKey, actionKey: source.actionKey, actionRevision: source.actionRevision, executionReference: $execution.id, eventId: source.eventId, correlationId: source.correlationId, attempt: source.attempt, state: 'reconcile_required', reasonCode }; })()) }}

nodes.notes: Reports only bounded reason codes and server-issued correlation; never forwards provider error payloads or customer data.
